quotes.quote_tibetan: In this Middle Autonomy system all these phenomena have a common mode of subsistence in that they (a) are posited by the power of appearing to undamaged awarenesses and (b) are established from their own side.
quotes.relevance: This quote discusses how phenomena are established or posited from their own side versus appearing to awareness, which is relevant to the discussion of the basis of negation and mode of subsistence in paragraph 4.
